infoAttributes.content: Custom attributes will be added to the most relevant HTML node.

perView.label: Slides in view
perView.description: Overrides the width. 1.2 shows a peek.

bleed.label: Full bleed
bleed.description: The first slide stays aligned with the content.

pattern.label: Pattern
pattern.description: Repeats along the slides. A slide's own width wins.

options.sides: On the sides, over the slides

navHover.label: Show on hover
navHover.description: Always shown where there is no hover.

dotsSpacing.label: Space from the buttons
dotsSpacing.description: Only when sharing the buttons' row.

barSpacing.label: Space from the buttons
barSpacing.description: Only when sharing the buttons' row.

builderView.label: Show it

options.open: Still, so you can style it

builderView.placeholder: Still, so you can style it
builderView.description: Working means it drags and plays here.

bfbeHoverOn.label: Responds to
bfbeHoverOn.description: The parent needs Children respond to hover.

bfbeHoverDelay.label: Delay
bfbeHoverDelay.description: Milliseconds, so parts arrive in sequence.

bfbeHoverScope.label: Children respond to hover
bfbeHoverScope.description: Parts inside set to A hovered parent move.

bfbeHsOver.label: Over the first section
bfbeHsOver.description: Only with the header over the first section.

bfbeHsDelay.label: Delay
bfbeHsDelay.description: Milliseconds, scrolling down only, so parts arrive in sequence.
